mainEntity.name: Does MMC have an office in Thane?

acceptedAnswer.text: We serve Thane from our Mumbai team and work from Mumbai and Indore. Our postal address is 4th Floor, Office No. 105, WeWork, Zenia Building, Hiranandani Business Park, Thane 400607, Maharashtra.
Our listed hours are Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 19:00, and Saturday, 10:00 to 14:00. You can also write to sales-in@mondaymarketing.company or call +91 766 630 9102. We reply inside one working day.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to come to Thane to work with you?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Most work runs on video calls and shared reports, so your business can be anywhere in India. If you want a first meeting in person, book a call and we will arrange it.

mainEntity.name: What does marketing for a Thane business involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually four things: a complete Google Business Profile for each place customers visit, a page on your site that says Thane clearly, honest handling of reviews, and ads aimed at the areas your buyers come from.

mainEntity.name: Can you manage several Thane outlets or branches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Each outlet gets its own verified profile with consistent details, and a page on your site that matches it. For brands with many outlets across cities, see Mumbai.

mainEntity.name: Do you guarantee a top local ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Nobody can honestly guarantee a ranking, a review or a timeline. We commit to the work in the monthly scope and report what we can observe.
A monthly scope, agreed after a call and written down so you can see what each month covers. We do not publish a price list.
